I don't have access to the specific NHANES database documentation needed to provide an exact count of cycles where PFOA (LBXPFOA) was measured.

To get this information accurately, I recommend:

1. Visiting the CDC's NHANES website (cdc.gov/nchs/nhanes)
2. Using the NHANES Laboratory Data documentation
3. Checking the variable documentation for LBXPFOA
4. Contacting CDC NHANES staff directly

They maintain complete records of which biomarkers were measured in each survey cycle.
